name: Garcia's Auto Shop
hook: Your customers on Old Harrisburg Road know exactly what an hour costs before they hand over the keys — the ones still comparing shops around Gettysburg could see your prices, your hours and a booking button on one page. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you run Garcia's Auto Shop on Old Harrisburg Road, Monday to Friday 8 to 5, you publish your rates ($60 an hour on cars, $75 on heavy-duty and European makes, $30 oil change, $35 diagnostics), and you handle everything from lock-outs and A/C service to water pumps, fuel pumps and engine or transmission replacement
na_stronie: your name, phone, e-mail and the Old Harrisburg Road address up front, your services in your own words (general maintenance, lock-outs, computer diagnostics, A/C service, truck oil changes, water pumps, fuel pumps, tire changes), your published prices exactly as you list them, Monday–Friday 8–5, online booking and a contact form that lands in your inbox, and your own photos from your page (the tool wall, the bay)
dlaczego: A driver in Gettysburg with a check-engine light searches on a phone and books the shop that shows a price and a button. A page of your own with your $35 diagnostic and $60 hour on it converts that search before anyone else's page loads.
